# Operator API route reference

The running pool serves the complete, version-matched contract at `GET /api/operator/v1/openapi.json`. All calls use `Authorization: Bearer poolop_…`.

## Read-only and read + write

| Method | Path | Operation |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/admin/accounts` | Sanitized provider account inventory |
| `GET` | `/admin/tokens` | Pool capacity counters |
| `GET` | `/api/console/analytics-health` | Accounting health and gaps |
| `GET` | `/api/console/audit` | Recent audit records with detail redacted |
| `GET` | `/api/console/principals/{id}/usage` | Selected member hourly usage |
| `GET` | `/api/console/principals` | Member ranking (hours up to 8784) |
| `GET` | `/api/me/usage` | Authenticated operator principal hourly usage |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1/accounting/requests` | Page through request-grain accounting facts |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1/config/pi` | Export Pi models.json using CODEX_POOL_MODEL_API_KEY |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1/guide` | Retrieve the operator workflow guide bundled with this deployment |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1/models` | Canonical model manifest with configured support and live readiness |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1/openapi.json` | Retrieve this deployed contract |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1/whoami` | Inspect effective token permissions |
| `GET` | `/api/operator/v1` | Discover the operator API |
| `GET` | `/api/passes` | Guest pass metadata without usable links |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/catalog` | Pool model catalog |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/daily-breakdown` | Codex upstream daily breakdown |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/hourly` | Global hourly usage (hours 1..168) |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/origins` | Hashed origin usage |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/signal` | All Signal Room graph series |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/stats` | Pool status dashboard data |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/users/{id}/daily` | User daily usage (days up to 90) |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/users/{id}/hourly` | User hourly usage (hours up to 168) |
| `GET` | `/api/pool/users` | Legacy usage leaderboard |

## Read + write only

| Method | Path | Operation |
|---|---|---|
| `DELETE` | `/api/passes/{id}` | Revoke guest pass |
| `PATCH` | `/api/passes/{id}` | Update guest pass |
| `PATCH` | `/api/principals/{id}` | Change principal status; role changes are browser-only |
| `POST` | `/admin/accounts/{id}/disable` | Disable provider account |
| `POST` | `/admin/accounts/{id}/enable` | Enable provider account |
| `POST` | `/admin/accounts/{id}/refresh` | Refresh provider account |
| `POST` | `/admin/accounts/{id}/resurrect` | Resurrect provider account |
| `POST` | `/admin/antigravity/models/sync` | Synchronize Antigravity models |
| `POST` | `/admin/antigravity/models/verify` | Verify Antigravity models |
| `POST` | `/admin/clear-rate-limits` | Clear provider cooldowns |
| `POST` | `/admin/economics` | Edit economics ledger |
| `POST` | `/admin/purge-anonymous` | Purge anonymous usage |
| `POST` | `/admin/reload` | Reload provider accounts |
| `POST` | `/api/console/members` | Issue a member onboarding link |
| `POST` | `/api/passes/{id}/restore` | Restore guest pass |
| `POST` | `/api/passes/{id}/rotate` | Replace guest pass link |
| `POST` | `/api/passes` | Issue a guest pass |
